title: Fit4Life - Digital intervention project for young families for the prevention of obesity and obesity - Pilot project
summary: Fit4Life is a digital prevention program for young Munich families with the aim of promoting healthy lifestyles and thus preventing obesity as major common diseases and pioneers of cardiovascular diseases in an interdisciplinary approach (sports and health sciences, medicine, life sciences, computer sciences).

interventions.name: Arm 1: Interventios group: Families receive in addition to questionnaires and measurements app for the prevention of obesity and overweight
Arm2: Control group: Families do not receive an app, only questionnaires and measurements for the prevention of obesity and overweight

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Healthy families after the birth of the first child
Understanding of German in language and writing (no mental impairment)
Residential 20 km radius of the hospital Harlaching
Exclusion criteria:
Age of guardians < 18 years
Families who do not understand the German language (questionnaires are currently not available in translation)
Diseases that require permanent medication before/during and after pregnancy
Multiple pregnancies, premature birth
Known maternal formative diseases such as medically diagnosed depression
